div.div:
Fig. 9 as drawn. The C4QB latch is transparent when a3 changes (C4QB is still high at C4I's rising edge), so a3 races through and D3 changes with D0 instead of 3 UI later.
Latches transparent while clock high. TA0–TA3 change together while C4I is low. Gray = latch transparent. Labels are bit indices bn, TAk carries b4m+k.
